## Overview

Teaching-assistant activity for **Calculus and Vector Analysis (2)** during the 2026 summer term at Yonsei University.

The work includes supporting problem-solving sessions and preparing instructional materials for the course.

## Public materials

No course materials are currently published on this page.

Materials will be added only after confirming that they are appropriate for public distribution and do not reproduce restricted textbook content or disclose student information.

## Topics

The course includes topics from multivariable and vector calculus, such as parametric surfaces, surface integrals, and the classical integral theorems of vector analysis.
